text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp has begun!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, it's hot!
Got hit with a whole mile of sweltering heat!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today's plan was just to do
some light exercise, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Plus, you must be tired from traveling.
Yeah. You're probably tired from traveling, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Can we play beach volleyball instead?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: “I have a personal rule: ‘Play outside as much as possible whenever the sun is dazzling!’”
choice_data_list: I see. In that case, I'll be the referee.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yayâª
I'm gonna go invite Love-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Gran-chan, is your next race the Hanshin Cup?
A sprint race!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But if we're talking a two-division conquest,
what about the Sprinters Stakes...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I took a longer adjustment period this time. 'Cause I'm planning to grow a lot this summer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Conditioning after the summer break in the Classic year is notoriously difficult, after all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Especially so for Gran-chan,
who aims to conquer three divisions.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were feeling a bit under the weather...
Are you all right now?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Even if it made me suffer for five miles!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A world of hurt...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well, but thanks to that,
I got a feel for where the bad line is.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I think I've gotten even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ! Fufu, that's so like you, Gran-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Even if it's one against three, I'm still gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: With a handicap like this, there's no way I can lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The summer training camp was intensely heated right from the start—
